title: Joiner, mover, leaver: one person's access over time
desc: Three phases in order. Joiner: Sam is hired and receives birthright access, the baseline everyone in that job gets from day one. Mover: Sam goes from Sales to Support; the risk is privilege accumulation, because Sam keeps the Sales access, so you review and confirm that the old access is still needed. Leaver: disabling the main account is not the whole job.
